basic_details.post_name: Project Engineer - Electronics / EXTC / ECE, Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Electronics, Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Mechanical and 5 more
basic_details.short_information: Society for Applied Microwave Electronics Engineering and Research (SAMEER), Kolkata, West Bengal, has invited applications for 34 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. 11/2026. The posts include Project Engineer - Electronics / EXTC / ECE, Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Electronics, Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Mechanical, Project Technical Assistant (A) - Electronics Mechanic and 4 more. Applications are accepted online until 15 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will SAMEER Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening based on Minimum Academic Qualification (minimum 55% marks) Written Test (online CBT or in-person) Online Interview / In-Person Interview Skill Test/Interaction for Project Scientific / Technical Assistant posts Written Test (CBT or in-person, qualifying marks 50%) Online Interview (ratio ordinarily 1:6)

content_sections.text: No TA/DA shall be admissible for appearing in Written Test, Skill Test, Online or In-Person Interview.

content_sections.text: Online Application Form Proof of Date of Birth Photo ID Proof Passport size photograph 10th Std. Mark Sheet 12th Std. Mark Sheet ITI Mark Sheet and Certificate Qualifying exam passing certificate and marks for all years

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SAMEER Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Applications shall be accepted online only through https://recruitment.sameer.gov.in up to midnight of the closing date. Pay application fee of Rs. 100/- online on the recruitment application portal. Edit application before final submission if needed, then click FINAL SUBMIT. Take a printout of the generated PDF of the submitted application. Produce the printout along with prescribed original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies at the time of interview/skill test. Apply on or before 15 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The Application Form should not be sent by post. Candidates must bring one set of self-attested photocopies of all documents along with originals for verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SAMEER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SAMEER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 34 vacancies: 7 Project Engineer - Electronics / EXTC / ECE, 6 Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Electronics, 2 Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Mechanical, 5 Project Technical Assistant (A) - Electronics Mechanic, 9 Project Technical Assistant (A) - Fitter, 2 Project Technical Assistant (A) - Machinist and 2 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SAMEER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All Candidates: Rs. 100.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Project Engineer - Electronics / EXTC / ECE: maximum 28 years; Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Electronics: maximum 25 years; Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Mechanical: maximum 25 years; Project Technical Assistant (A) - Electronics Mechanic: maximum 25 years; Project Technical Assistant (A) - Fitter: maximum 25 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 34,000 per month for Project Engineer - Electronics / EXTC / ECE, Rs. 23,500 per month for Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Electronics, Rs. 23,500 per month for Project Scientific Assistant (A) - Mechanical, Rs. 21,000 per month for Project Technical Assistant (A) - Electronics Mechanic, Rs. 21,000 per month for Project Technical Assistant (A) - Fitter.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc/M.Tech/Ph.D, Diploma, ITI with NAC/NTC, B.Sc/B.Com/B.A with MBA or Graduation. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Appointments are purely contractual and project-specific. Applications from Indian citizens only shall be considered. Selected candidates who are currently employed shall submit a relieving letter at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates previously engaged with any SAMEER Centre as RS, PE or PA for an aggregate period of 5 years or more are not eligible for PE or PA posts.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening based on Minimum Academic Qualification (minimum 55% marks). Written Test (online CBT or in-person). Online Interview / In-Person Interview. Skill Test/Interaction for Project Scientific / Technical Assistant posts.
